verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's homepage presents entity registration and Unique Entity ID issuance, its core transaction, as something you start on the site. The sam.gov workspace also exposes account pages. However, the evidence is a single call-to-action line and does not describe an end-to-end online registration workflow. Missing for 10: documented step-by-step online registration flow, confirmation that registration is completed and submitted entirely online, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Register your entity or get a Unique Entity ID to get started doing business with the federal government.
registered users must obtain the API Key from the https://sam.gov/workspace/profile/account-details page
